implementation_summary: Added hierarchy.ts with two exports. buildPageHierarchy(pages, startPath) builds the tree using the Q-23 rules. The start page is the root ('start'). The rules then run one at a time over all pages, so a stronger rule always wins. Menu: parent is the nearest menu item above the page that links to a recorded page; a top-level item goes under the root. Breadcrumb: the last breadcrumb link before the current page. The current page is the first crumb that links to itself; otherwise the trail ends at the current page. Path: the nearest recorded ancestor path, or else the root. A candidate parent is skipped and the next rule is tried when it is not recorded, is the page itself, or its ancestor chain already contains the page. That keeps the tree free of cycles. Menu and breadcrumb hrefs are resolved against the page's raw.url, only same-host targets count, and they are turned into path+query with redactUrl, the same as page-content. Matching recorded paths ignores a trailing slash. If a path appears twice, the first one is kept. Children are sorted by urlPath in plain code-unit order, so crawl order does not change the tree. If the start page is not among the pages, a root with title null is made. The navigation map lists, for each recorded page, every ContentLink without leavesSite as {from, to, region, text}. internalLinking(hierarchy, recordedPaths) gives every recorded page an inbound count, counting only links from other recorded pages (self-links ignored). unlinkedPages lists recorded pages with 0 inbound links, in recordedPaths order, never the root.

risks: Choice made here: rules are applied in phases (all menu placements, then breadcrumbs, then path), not page by page. When pages conflict, the stronger rule wins regardless of crawl order.

Choice made here: if the last breadcrumb link points to a page that was not recorded, the page falls through to the path rule instead of trying an earlier crumb. The task says 'falls through to the next rule'.
inboundCounts counts links, not distinct linking pages. Menu and footer links on every page inflate the counts by design.
Recorded paths are matched with the trailing slash ignored. Query strings must match exactly.
handoff: Import buildPageHierarchy and internalLinking from packages/core/src/audit/analysis/hierarchy.ts. The input type HierarchyPage is {urlPath, title, raw: RawPage, content: PageContent}. Pass the start page's urlPath as startPath. Call internalLinking(hierarchy, recordedPaths) with the same recorded paths. The start page is taken to be hierarchy.root.urlPath. Neither function makes a request or reads the clock.
